task.description:
Produce a design artefact for SBX-04, SBX-05, SBX-06 (stage 17 — sandbox ownership binding, inaccessible-sandbox sentinel, and claim/release/reclaim audit).

Requirements summary:
- SBX-04: A claim binds the sandbox to triple (tenant_id, agent_principal, task_spec_id) under unique index ux_sandbox_owner. One sandbox → one owner, one task_spec → one sandbox. Cross-principal claim → HTTP 409 sandbox_already_claimed (no owner name disclosed). Operations inside claimed sandbox check bound agent_principal; mismatch → SBX-05 sentinel.
- SBX-05: All inaccessible cases (nonexistent, wrong tenant, wrong principal) return HTTP 403 sandbox_not_accessible with byte-identical body/headers. Tenant predicate in same query as row load. Probe rate: 20 sentinels in 60s → HTTP 429 probe_rate_exceeded.
- SBX-06: Only bound agent_principal may release; others get sandbox_not_accessible. Pool manager reclaims after 60 min idle. Audit entries for: Claimed, ClaimRejected, Released, Reclaimed — each carrying acting_principal, tenant_id, sandbox_id, task_spec_id.

Produce design artefact at: src/design/sbx04-06-design.md

Design must cover:
1. Database schema changes: new columns/indexes on `sandboxes` table for owner binding (agent_principal, task_spec_id, claimed_at columns; unique index ux_sandbox_owner on (tenant_id, task_spec_id))
2. New audit event types: SandboxClaimed, SandboxClaimRejected, SandboxReleased, SandboxReclaimed
3. API endpoint changes:
   - PATCH /sandboxes/{id}/claim — bind ownership (SBX-04)
   - DELETE /sandboxes/{id}/claim — release ownership (SBX-06)
   - All existing sandbox operation endpoints — SBX-05 sentinel enforcement
4. Probe rate-limiting logic for sandbox_not_accessible (SBX-05): sliding window counter per principal per tenant, 20 responses / 60 seconds → 429
5. Pool manager idle-reclaim logic: background sweep checking last_active_at, 60 min threshold (SBX-06)
6. Zig type signatures for new functions (no implementation code)
7. Migration file name (e.g. migrations/NNN_sandbox_ownership.sql)

Design must NOT contain implementation code — interfaces, types, data-flow only.

Compliance note: SBX-05 byte-identical response bodies and same query shape for all sentinel cases is a hard security invariant (probe indistinguishability). Design must explicitly state how this is achieved.

Return PASS with artifact path src/design/sbx04-06-design.md.
